title.en: An Act to Authorize the Segregation of the Subprovince of Abra From the Province of Ilocos Sur and the Reestablishment of the Former Province of Abra, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
Whenever the public interest shall require it, , the Governor-General may, by executive order,
reestablish as a province the former Province of Abra, which was consolidated with Ilocos Sur in accordance
with Act Numbered Thirteen hundred and six. The provisions hereof shall take effect upon the promulgation
of said executive order or on the date designated in said order.

The Province of Abra so reestablished shall have the same territory as it had before its
consolidation with Ilocos Sur, above referred to, and the provisions of the Provincial Law of the
Administrative Code shall, in so far as the same are applicable, govern as to the administration and operation
of said province. The capital of the province shall be the municipality of Bangued.

The offices of provincial governor and members of the provincial board of the Province of Abra
shall be filled by popular election, in accordance with the provisions of the existing Election Law: Provided,
however, That the present lieutenant-governor of Abra, elected at the general election on June sixth, nineteen
hundred and sixteen, shall hold office as provincial governor of the newT province until his successor shall
have been elected at the next general election and have qualified: Provided, further, That the members of the
new provincial board of Abra shall be appointed by the Governor-General, by and with the consent of the
Senate, and shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected at the next general election and
have duly qualified.

The provincial officers of Abra shall receive annual compensation at a rate to be fixed by the
provincial board of said province, which shall in no case exceed two thousand pesos for the provincial
governor, nineteen hundred pesos for the provincial treasurer, and eighteen hundred pesos for the provincial

The members of the provincial board of Abra shall receive a per diem which shall be fixed by
the provincial board and shall not exceed five pesos for each session of the board actually attended.

The Province of Abra shall also be organized into a representative district. The present
Representative for the Third Electoral District of Ilocos Sur shall be known during his term of office as
Representative from the Province of Abra. At the next election for the office of Representative, the
municipality of Santa, Province of Ilocos Sur, which has heretofore, together with the subprovince of Abra,
composed the Third Electoral District of Ilocos Sur, shall, upon the promulgation of the executive order or on
the date fixed in said order, form part of the Second Electoral District of Ilocos Sur. The Province of Abra
shall continue to form part of the First Senatorial District as heretofore. As soon as this Act is put into effect
by executive order, the distribution of the members of the House of Representatives provided for in section
one hundred and thirty-six of the Administrative Code shall be corrected in accordance with the provisions of

The funds and liabilities as well as the property of all classes which shall belong to the Province
of Ilocos Sur and the new Province of Abra, upon the reestablishment of the latter, shall be equitably

distributed among both in the manner directed by the Insular Auditor, with the approval of the
Governor-General first had.

All Acts or parts of Acts inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.
Approved, March 9, 1917.
